visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor space. He holds a sleek, ergonomic black bottle in his right hand. He smiles and gestures towards the bottle. A graphic appears showing three black skincare products on a shelf with a mirror background. (2) Back to the man, he continues to talk while holding the bottle. Text overlays appear near his hand detailing skin benefits. He uses his free hand to emphasize his points, moving his fingers and changing facial expressions from a smile to focused explanation. (3) He removes the cap of the black bottle with a distinct motion. He sprays or pours a liquid onto his left cheek and begins massaging his face with both hands. He looks directly into the camera, demonstrating the application technique on his forehead and cheeks. (4) The scene shifts slightly as he holds a different, slightly curved black bottle. He applies a creamy white substance to his cheek using his index finger. He rubs the lotion onto his face and neck with smooth, upward strokes, maintaining eye contact with the viewer. (5) He holds a round black jar. He uses a small black spatula to scoop a white cream out of the jar. He applies a streak of cream to his cheek and spreads it with his fingers. He uses the palms of his hands to lift his facial skin upwards near the jawline. (6) The man frames his face with both hands, showing off a glowing complexion. He gives a thumbs up and a bright smile. The video concludes with the final graphic of the three products on the shelf with branding text.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A well-groomed young adult male with dark styled hair wearing a simple white crew-neck t-shirt. He has a small tattoo visible on his left inner forearm.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is a clean, modern indoor space with dark cabinetry or wall panels and a vertical light strip. A secondary background used for product shots features a mirrored vanity or shelf area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young male voice speaks with high energy and clarity over an upbeat, rhythmic electronic track featuring a steady 4/4 drum machine beat and bright synthesizer pads. (2) A subtle whoosh sound effect coincides with a visual transition. The speaker's tone remains friendly and persuasive as he introduces the brand name. (3) A small mechanical click is heard when the product cap is removed. The speaker maintains a fast speech rate while describing ingredients, with his voice layered cleanly over the continuous BGM. (4) Light percussive 'tap' sounds (incidental noise from skin application) are audible beneath the narration as the speaker explains the application process. (5) The BGM continues without interruption, providing a consistent high-energy backdrop as the speaker concludes with a high-pitched, enthusiastic recommendation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature 1 -> Application Demo 1 -> Product Feature 2 -> Application Demo 2 -> Final Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-production value endorsement and instructional guide for the POLA B.A skincare series. By combining a charismatic male presenter with rapid editing, upbeat music, and on-screen text, the video aims to position the products as premium, artistic 'must-haves' while demonstrating their texture and usage for maximum consumer appeal.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly mentions the brand 'POLA', shows the full product line, and the speaker recommends viewers visit the POLA counter.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high-arousal audio-visual combination common in Douyin/TikTok beauty marketing to maintain viewer retention.
